title: The story behind the struggle
lead: From volunteering in his own neighbourhood to leading a movement across many communities, Janak Adhikari's work has one thread: people know best what their community needs.
biography: Janak Adhikari began as a young volunteer, running evening classes for children who could not afford tuition. What he saw there, bright students held back by cost and distance, shaped everything that followed.

In the years since, he has organised health camps, taken local grievances to district offices and helped families claim entitlements they did not know they had. He founded Sangharsh Samajik Sanstha to give that work a lasting home.
He remains in the field every week. His approach is simple: listen, act with the community, publish the results and invite criticism.
